comments.note: nodes.py: _get_next_counter() accepts counter_length as a parameter but does not use it (per design — flexible \d+ matching is unconditional). The parameter is kept for interface consistency with the call site in SaveJsonNode.execute(). No action needed, but a caller reading the signature may expect it to affect the regex pattern. A docstring clarification (already present) is sufficient.
